observation.happening: Home screen of a productivity/task-management app with AI-powered personalization. Main content shows a task list with calendar items (MOPITA, MTI, 採用, etc.). Right sidebar displays Astra AI's inferences about the user's work patterns with feedback buttons.
observation.most_important: Successfully integrates multiple information types—tasks, calendar, and AI-generated insights—into a cohesive layout. The right panel enables active learning through user feedback on AI suggestions.
observation.next_action: User can select tasks, expand items with the chevron, provide feedback via blue affirmative/gray negative buttons, or view source information via blue links.
anomalies: Right sidebar has a visible scrollbar, indicating content below the fold
Gray descriptive text in sidebar has lower contrast against light background
Density in the right panel is high—multiple small buttons and compressed text sections compete for attention

concerns.what: Gray text (e.g., descriptive text in right sidebar like 'Astra が提している あなたのの情報') has insufficient contrast against the light background
concerns.where: Right sidebar, particularly non-header text and subtle labels

concerns.what: Right sidebar packs too much content (section headers, small buttons, status indicators) in narrow column; scrollbar indicates overflow
concerns.where: Right sidebar panel, multiple stacked suggestion items with inline buttons

concerns.what: Relationship between main task list and right-sidebar feedback is unclear; sidebar feels like a secondary layer but occupies significant screen real estate
concerns.where: Overall layout balance between content and learning-feedback panel
